prose:
An FT item indexed by Techmeme attributes skepticism about AI curing cancer within five to ten years to Novartis CEO and Anthropic board member Vas Narasimhan. The excerpt contrasts an engineering-oriented outlook with the complexity of human biology and places his comments against more ambitious technology-industry predictions.

The full article timed out, so the interview context, qualifications and specific evidence were not inspected. A disagreement over a broad timetable is not a clinical result or proof that AI will or will not improve particular treatments. The summary stays within the accessible excerpt and does not turn a forecast into medical advice or a guarantee about cancer research.
highlights: FT excerpt attributes skepticism to Narasimhan
Time horizon discussed is five to ten years
Biological complexity is the stated concern
No clinical outcome or universal limit is established
This is a reported viewpoint rather than medical advice
